question: Which Pala ruler temporarily occupied Kanauj?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dharmapala**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Dharmapala** was a significant ruler of the Pala dynasty who temporarily occupied Kanauj.
 
• He was the son of Gopala, the founder of the Pala dynasty, and succeeded him in the throne.
 
• Dharmapala is known for his military conquests and for expanding the Pala Empire, making it one of the dominant powers
